name: Landhaus Sammer - Hotel Garni
beschreibung: Landhaus Sammer - Hotel Garni welcomes vacationers to a quiet, sunny setting in Tannheim in Tyrol's beloved Tannheim Valley. This privately managed hotel garni combines traditional alpine country architecture with heartfelt Tyrolean hospitality. Comfortable guest rooms feature private balconies offering captivating vistas of the surrounding alpine peaks. For soothing relaxation after outdoor excursions, guests can enjoy a dedicated spa area with sauna, infrared cabin, and quiet lounge. A bountiful gourmet breakfast buffet provides a wonderful start. The Neunerköpfle cable car, valley hiking trails, and cross-country ski tracks are all nearby.
kurzbeschreibung: Charming Bed & Breakfast hotel in Tannheim in the Tannheim Valley featuring a sauna and panoramic alpine views.
